defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: China
maps.description: China is a vast country in East Asia, featuring a diverse landscape of mountains, deserts, and rivers, and is home to one of the world's oldest civilizations.

maps.name: Denmark
maps.description: Denmark is a Scandinavian country comprising the Jutland peninsula and numerous islands, known for its coastal geography, Viking heritage, and modern design.

maps.name: Europe
maps.description: Europe is a continent located entirely in the Northern Hemisphere and mostly in the Eastern Hemisphere, comprising the westernmost peninsulas of Eurasia and home to diverse cultures and nations.

maps.name: Finland
maps.description: Finland is a Nordic country situated between Sweden, Norway, and Russia, characterized by its vast forests, tens of thousands of lakes, and the phenomenon of the midnight sun.

maps.name: France
maps.description: France is a Western European nation spanning from the Mediterranean to the English Channel and the North Sea, renowned for its rich history, diverse landscapes, and cultural influence.

maps.name: Great Britain
maps.description: Great Britain is an island in the North Atlantic Ocean off the north-west coast of continental Europe, consisting of the countries England, Scotland, and Wales.

maps.name: Germany
maps.description: Germany is a Central European country bordered by the North Sea, the Alps, and the Baltic Sea, known for its varied terrain, dense forests, and major rivers like the Rhine.
